description: Enforcement-doctrine gate 1: the ORCHESTRATOR (main thread) must dispatch a subagent in the BACKGROUND. Fires on the Task/Agent dispatch tool (pre-tool point); if run_in_background isn't truthy, a non-trivial dispatch is BLOCKED with a 3-part reminder (why / set run_in_background:true or a Workflow / orchestrator-plans-dispatches-verifies), a trivial one warns. SUBAGENTS are EXEMPT (CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION). Honest escape hatch: ALLOW_FOREGROUND_SUBAGENT=1 + ALLOW_FOREGROUND_SUBAGENT_REASON='why', or an inline `foreground-subagent-ok: why` in the prompt. on_error=open: a behavioral nudge must never wedge dispatching.
